user.title: Connect to LabTether Hub
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to an existing LabTether hub. HTTPS is required except for loopback addresses. For a private CA, place its PEM file inside Home Assistant and enter its absolute path; keep certificate checks enabled. Insecure HTTP and TLS bypass require explicit consent.
